The following guidance should be followed when submitting such studies: • Each study should be submitted separately, with its own Study ID and Study Tagging file (STF). For example, a report that includes both a maximum tolerated dose study and a 7-day repeat dose toxicity study should be submitted as two separate studies. • The report should be submitted once and referenced in all applicable STFs.
